quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 half-year report (DART, filed 2026-08-14, consolidated): Q2 (April-June 2026) revenue KRW 56,777M (+16% YoY vs KRW 48,894M) with operating profit KRW 12,508M (22.0% margin) vs KRW 6,361M a year ago (+97% YoY); Q2 net income KRW 5,080M. H1 2026 revenue KRW 109,176M (+31% YoY vs KRW 83,481M), operating profit KRW 22,210M (20.3% margin, +173% YoY vs KRW 8,144M) but net loss KRW 1,018M (vs net income KRW 20,135M in H1 2025) because of KRW 12,629M currency-forward valuation losses and KRW 8,967M forward settlement losses (USD short forwards of USD 148M with Woori, KB, KDB and Samsung Futures at 1,129-1,438 KRW/USD) plus KRW 8,895M interest expense. Segment: semiconductor equipment KRW 103,072M revenue / KRW 21,335M OP; display equipment (ENC Technology) KRW 7,215M / KRW 479M. Product mix H1: test handlers and other equipment KRW 51,201M (46.9%; memory test equipment alone 47.4% of group sales vs 31.3% in FY2025), change-over kits KRW 33,712M (30.9%), parts and boards KRW 17,690M (16.2%), display KRW 6,548M (6.0%). Exports KRW 86,588M (79%) vs domestic KRW 22,588M; by destination Korea KRW 22,588M, China KRW 27,477M, Malaysia KRW 16,219M, India KRW 13,738M (from KRW 1,994M a year ago), Taiwan KRW 11,571M, Singapore KRW 7,446M, US KRW 5,963M. Customer concentration: customer A KRW 61,421M = 56.3% of consolidated revenue (42.8% a year ago); on a separate basis customer A 59.9% and customer F 10.6%. Top-3 customers H1: A KRW 61,421M, F KRW 10,932M, G KRW 9,249M, plus 47 other customers KRW 27,574M. FY2025 reference: revenue KRW 159,128M / OP KRW 15,838M. Cash KRW 61,893M at 2026-06-30; total borrowings incl. the KRW 93,314M zero-coupon exchangeable bond (exchange price KRW 71,060, exchange period 2026-01-20 to 2030-09-20) KRW 339,765M. Dividend KRW 130/share (KRW 4,646M) paid for FY2025.

quarterly_data.signal: Order backlog (equipment only, parts excluded) at 2026-06-30 / as of report date 2026-08-07: semiconductor equipment KRW 55,508M with main customers named as MICRON and SK HYNIX, display equipment KRW 4,760M (Samsung Display and others), total KRW 60,268M. The filing states order-to-delivery lead times are short so backlog is a weak revenue predictor. Customer advance payments (contract liabilities for point-in-time performance obligations) jumped to KRW 32,204M at 2026-06-30 from KRW 1,627M at 2025-12-31, and work-in-process inventory rose to KRW 94,559M from KRW 76,018M (total inventory KRW 133,049M, 20.5% of assets) - both pointing to equipment builds in progress against orders. Disclosed customer base: SK Hynix, Samsung, Micron, Intel, Infineon. Related disclosed supply contracts: HBM test equipment KRW 9,720M to Samsung (signed 2026-05-18, 6.11% of FY2025 revenue, final delivery extended to 2026-09-29 with contract end 2026-10-30) and semiconductor test equipment USD 6,504,000 / KRW 9,185M to Micron India (signed 2026-08-07, 5.77% of FY2025 revenue, deliveries 2026-10-16 to 2027-05-16).
quarterly_data.figure: equipment backlog KRW 60,268M at 2026-08-07 (semi KRW 55,508M: Micron, SK Hynix; display KRW 4,760M); customer advances KRW 32.2B vs 1.6B at year-end

quarterly_data.signal: Capacity and capex: Techwing designs and final-assembles test equipment with parts outsourced, so it does not report capacity or utilisation. H1 2026 tangible-asset purchases KRW 29,433M cash (KRW 24,585M a year ago); PP&E rose to KRW 277,471M from KRW 252,183M with construction in progress up to KRW 21,210M from KRW 9,806M. Board approved on 2026-03-03 the purchase of industrial land in the Cheonan BIT industrial complex for KRW 15.6B (land acquired KRW 16,042M in H1; Cheonan site land now KRW 62,007M) and on 2026-05-15 the disposal of the Dongtan Plant 2 (land and building, book KRW 23,321M, reclassified as held for sale) for KRW 59.5B, expected to close in 2026. Of the KRW 93,314M exchangeable bond raised 2025-10-20, KRW 25,000M was earmarked for a new-product manufacturing facility extension, KRW 11,727M spent by 2026-06-30. Existing sites: Dongtan HQ (expanded 2024-05), Anseong plant, Asan plant 2 (second expansion completed 2025-07 adding production capacity). Raw-material purchases H1 KRW 63,851M (frames KRW 7,415M, change-over kits KRW 15,244M, servo motors KRW 2,363M, small milling KRW 3,033M); outsourced processing KRW 4,387M (cable wiring, manipulator, chamber, part machining). Related-party suppliers Dasom Tech (purchases KRW 5,930M), Nano Ace (KRW 4,636M) and Trutech (KRW 10,861M) supplied KRW 21,426M of parts in H1. R&D spend H1 KRW 10,840M = 10.57% of revenue; 905 registered patents (485 Korea, 420 overseas). Headcount 610.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 capex KRW 29.4B; CIP KRW 21.2B; Cheonan land bought KRW 15.6B; Dongtan Plant 2 sale KRW 59.5B approved 2026-05-15; R&D 10.6% of sales

quarterly_data.signal: Product pipeline as described in the half-year report: (1) CUBE PROBER - HBM test equipment that fully inspects HBM at the individual-stack level with sub-5-micrometre vision precision, skipping the loader/unloader/COK tray steps by transferring wafers directly to the chuck; first Samsung HBM Cube Prober order won 2025-01 and a KRW 9,720M HBM test equipment supply contract with Samsung disclosed 2026-05-19; filing says the HBM market is led by SK Hynix, Samsung and Micron and that stacked-die (TSV) inspection difficulty is driving double-digit annual growth in memory ATE. (2) Probe stations TWP300 (in mass-production lines) and second-generation-vision TWP300H targeting localisation of a market dominated by Tokyo Electron and other Japanese vendors. (3) Burn-in chambers and sorters - started with overseas SSD burn-in, expanding to DRAM and non-memory; eSSD / PCIe 5.0-6.0 burn-in demand tied to AI data-center build-outs. (4) Memory, non-memory (SoC) and module/SSD test handlers plus change-over kits and interface boards sold as a handler-plus-board total solution. Filing frames test and inspection equipment as the fastest-growing equipment segment because HBM-style advanced packaging requires 100% inspection at each process step, raising both ASP and unit counts. Corporate: new Taiwan branch manager approved 2026-07-07; subsidiary CK Electronic Technology Nanjing liquidated in H1; charter amended 2026-03-24 to rename outside directors as independent directors and extend directors' duty of loyalty to shareholders; KRW 15,000M of capital surplus transferred to retained earnings.
quarterly_data.figure: Cube Prober (sub-5um vision, per-stack HBM full inspection) + TWP300/TWP300H probe stations + SSD/DRAM burn-in expanding; first Samsung Cube Prober order 2025-01
